html:
Tint a Car is well known for our vehicle window tinting, but did you know that we also do commercial window tinting? Below is information on the commercial window tinting we do including both office building and commercial vehicle window tint.

Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs for almost 50 years and are the country’s most trusted window tinting network. All our films are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality and all installations are done by professionally trained installers. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on car tints, no questions asked and peace of mind lifetime Warranties at all stores, Australia-wide. In addition to our car and home window tinting services, here are the commercial window tinting services we offer

Commercial Vehicle Window Tint And Office Window Tint Services

With our commercial window tinting for office buildings and commercial spaces we have a range of different tints to choose from.

Our heat and solar films are ideal for office spaces with computer screens as it reduces the amount of glare entering your office and minimises reflections on screens. It also helps to keep the heat out so your office space is cooler in the warmer months and reduces fading & damage to your flooring & furnishings too.

Privacy film is a great choice if you want to block the view into your office from those on the outside, especially if you have expensive equipment you don’t want visible.

Our safety films and security films are also great for keeping your valuable office equipment secure and also keep you and your staff safer too by minimising the risk of injury if the glass is broken.

Our decorative film is popular for commercial window tinting as it can be used internally as a divider or to create privacy within the office. It can also be customised to include your logo or branding. Other benefits of commercial window tinting include:

  • Improving the energy efficiency of your heating and cooling systems – commercial window tinting could reduce the amount of energy exchange through your windows, leading to increased efficiency of your HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) system.
  • Creating a more comfortable temperature for your employees to work in which can boost productivity
  • Adds a layer of security – installing anti-graffiti commercial tinting or security window film, improves the security of your commercial premises in the event of break-ins or vandalism.

Commercial Vehicle Window Tint

Through our commercial vehicle window tint service we also have several different film options to choose from, ideal for protecting your company’s fleet of vehicles and drivers who spend a lot of time driving. Commercial vehicle window tint protects your staff on the road from exposure to harmful UV rays as well as your car’s interior as UV rays can cause weathering and fading. Break-ins can be prevented with security film that holds shattered glass together (also making your fleet safer for your drivers).

Enquire About Commercial Window Tinting Today

To find out more about commercial window tinting for your workspace or our commercial vehicle window tint, call 13 TINT or contact your local Tint a Car commercial window tinting store to speak with your local window tinting experts.
